subject.title: photoshop tools
subject.subtitle: process guide
subject.blurb: Panels, scripts and actions built for Photoshop. What every control does, how a file travels from the canvas out to whatever does the work and back again, and the things each one needs you to remember.

items.name: Nano Banana Bridge
items.tagline: Sends the canvas and a marked-up selection to Nano Banana, then brings the result back as a masked layer.

items.name: GlitchSlice
items.tagline: Slices a layer into strips and scatters them — the criss-cross glitch pass, one direction at a time.

items.name: Signal Degrade
items.tagline: One pass of lo-fi abuse: misregistration, halo, crush, grain, vignette — any stage at 0 is skipped.

items.name: Static
items.tagline: Generates a canvas-sized noise layer from mixable ingredients — radio static, hum bars, scanlines, dropout.

items.name: Row Jitter
items.tagline: Shifts every horizontal band of a layer sideways — VHS tracking, worn tape, a scan gone wrong.

items.name: Misregistered Print
items.tagline: The cheap-print look: halftone dots, colour plates out of register, paper grain and warmth.
